title: Household-Size Schedule for Eligibility-Transition Waivers
content:
**Schedule.** Under the household-size schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the eligibility-transition waiver of a Pre-K tuition late fee has an amount added by the number of the household's children holding a School Nutrition Services Meal Account in status active.

| Children of the household holding a School Nutrition Services meal account in status active | Added to the waiver |
|---|---|
| three or more | 5.00 |
| exactly two | 2.50 |
| one or none | nothing |

Every active meal account of the household counts, whatever its tier; an inactive account does not.

## Examples (hypothetical households)

| Active meal accounts in the household | Added |
|---|---|
| 3 | 5.00 |
| 2 | 2.50 |
| 1 | nothing |
